title: Fixed version is a breaking major upgrade
description: AutoMapper 8.1.1 with a (synthetic) advisory fixed only in 9.0.0, which removed the static Mapper API the code uses. The bump does not compile, so the verifier must stop it: no fix PR, escalate to a human (fix_failed).
notes: The pipeline has no explicit major-version guard; the build/test verifier is what stops the PR. The pipeline retries a failed fix up to policies.retries.max_fix_retries; the harness makes one attempt.
